# Minutemen Heavy Trooper
Heavy Troopers are combat specialists above Private and below Corporal. They support their fireteam and obey their Corporals, Sergeants, and officers; they do not command squads. Two Heavy Troopers may serve at once. The role requires five hours as a Minutemen Private.
Their salvaged plate armor provides 50% blunt, slash, piercing, and heat protection, plus 60% explosion resistance, at a 15% walking and running slowdown. It is conventional armor, not powered armor. The matching helmet does not add another layer of armor protection.
## Chest knife
Alt-click your equipped armor to draw the chest-mounted combat knife. Shift-click examines its description and protection details. Use a combat knife on the armor to put it back. The knife disappears from the armor when removed and appears again when sheathed.
## Vertibird blade
The salvaged vertibird rotor is a large two-handed melee weapon that knocks struck enemies back using the same knockback behavior as a super sledge. Both hands must be free to pick it up. Stow it on your back or in your armor's weapon slot when you need your hands for another task. ## Heavy laser musket
Wield the musket in both hands to fire. Alt-click it, or choose Crank from its menu, to strengthen the next shot. It fires for 20 heat damage without cranking. One three-second crank raises this to 75 heat damage; firing consumes the stored crank charge. Spare microfusion cells are carried in the backpack. While wielding the musket, use the scope action to look farther ahead; movement is slowed while scoped.
Heavy Troopers also receive a Minutemen duster, a ranger gas mask with night vision, and blackened bladed gauntlets.
